To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) CNNs are well suited for time series forecasting, b) they are able to capture dependencies between multiple time series, c) they are able perform long term prediction and d) they can do so with a small number of training examples.

(1) Convolutional neural networks can be used to learn temporal dependencies in financial data, (2) The WaveNet architecture is more effective in learning these dependencies compared to a fully convolutional neural network and (3) The WaveNet model is able to forecast the future value of a time series more accurately than a standard autoregressive model.

The main takeaway from our work is that

convolutional neural networks are able to learn the dependencies between multiple financial time series, and can be used as a forecasting method for time series with non linear trends and non stationary noise, such as financial time series.
the WaveNet architecture is able to learn long term dependencies between multiple financial time series in an efficient manner.
